faqs.q: Do I retain 100% of my master rights?
faqs.a: Yes. Every project produced under VEXO Music production services provides the client with 100% commercial master ownership and rights upon completion.

faqs.q: Can I attend the studio session in person or work remotely?
faqs.a: Both! You are welcome to record live in our Jaipur studio or collaborate remotely with our engineers via real-time high-fidelity streaming sessions.

faqs.q: How are revisions handled if I want adjustments?
faqs.a: We provide structured revision rounds with time-stamped feedback. Revisions are completed rapidly until you are 100% satisfied with the mix and master.
